title: UNIQON Billing Pro • Build 282 (Smart Seal & Signature Photo-to-PNG Studio)
highlights: Smart Seal & Signature Photo-to-PNG Studio (Windows & Android): Photograph your physical company rubber seal or paper signature using your phone camera or upload a file. The app automatically detects and removes the white paper background and shadows into a clean 32-bit transparent PNG.
Intelligent Edge Falloff & Auto-Crop: Automatically detects ink bounds and crops excess empty white paper borders with comfortable padding for sharp invoice printing.
Official Ink Color Palettes: Keep original ink colors or re-ink with Classic Stamp Blue (#0F4C81), Stamp Violet (#581C87), Jet Black (#111827), Official Red (#B91C1C), or Emerald Green (#047857).
Seamless Invoice & PDF Integration: 1-click button to apply directly as Company Seal or Authorised Signature in Invoice Settings and Desktop Live Invoice Sheet.
Full Cross-Platform Support: Runs with background isolate processing on both Windows and Android without any native dependencies.
fixes: Added SmartStampService with background isolate processing for instant paper background removal.
Added SmartStampConverterDialog with live transparency checkerboard preview, sensitivity adjustment slider, and auto-crop.
Added direct Magic Photo-to-PNG buttons in Invoice Settings and Desktop Live Invoice Studio.
Updated Build 282 Windows installer and Android release packages.
